data.text:
FLOOD ALERT | Heavy rainfall resulted in flooding on major thoroughfares in Quezon City on Saturday, August 30, as reported by the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority.
 
The MMDA announced that the areas of Commonwealth Avenue near the University of the Philippines Gymnasium in Diliman, as well as both lanes of the Quezon Avenue EDSA Tunnel, were declared not passable for all types of vehicles due to waist-deep water levels.

Knee-deep flooding also led to slow traffic along Commonwealth Avenue near Winston, Katipunan Avenue, Aurora Boulevard, Circumferential Road 5 (C-5 Road), the southbound lane of Mother Ignacia Street, Araneta Avenue, and Maria Clara Street, while above gutter-deep floods were monitored in front of the Lung Center of the Philippines on Quezon Avenue and in front of Ever Gotesco along Commonwealth Avenue.

The MMDA reported gutter-deep flooding in the areas of EDSA Centris Service Road, Munoz Street, Elliptical Road near Kalayaan Avenue, in front of Ateneo de Manila, EDSA Kamuning, and on Dona Carmen. | Joel Zurbano

data.text:
Umabot sa 105 mm ang naitalang buhos ng tubig ulan mula 2 pm-3 pm ngayong araw, base sa datos ng Science  Garden Station ng MMDA -EFCOS na located sa DOST-PAGASA Compound Quezon City. 

Umapaw ang mga ilog at nabulunan sa dami ng tubig ang mga maliliit na imburnal na mabilis na nagpalubog sa maraming lugar sa Quezon City.

Kung ihahambing sa bagyong "Ondoy" noong Setyembre 2009, ang tubig ulan na ibinagsak nito sa loob ng anim na oras ay umabot sa 455 mm, na katumbas ng 75.83 mm/oras.

Bagamat maraming kalsada ang binaha, mabilis naman humupa ang tubig-baha dahil sa regular na paglilinis ng drainage system sa siyudad at paghina ng intensity ng pag-ulan pagkatapos ng isang oras.
#mmda
